review_candidates.title: Azure Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Location - Bangalore/Chennai Mode of work - WFO YOE - 5Years+ Notice period - Immediate to 30days Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure Developer to design, automate, and maintain enterprise-grade cloud environments on Microsoft Azure. You will be directly responsible for establishing robust security baselines using Microsoft Defender for Cloud (Azure Defender), implementing granular Network RBAC and segmentation policies, and driving full lifecycle deployment automation
eligibility_evidence: Observability as Code: Define and implement monitoring, logging, and alerting frameworks across hybrid/cloud workloads using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics (KQL), Prometheus, and Grafana to proactively detect degradation and auto-remediate known failure modes.

Third-Party Observability: Experience instrumenting hybrid observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, Splunk) alongside Azure Monitor and Log Analytics (KQL) for distributed tracing and alerting.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Must-Have Requirements: Azure Cloud Architecture & Core Networking: 5+ years of hands-on experience provisioning and supporting Azure environments, including Virtual Networks (VNets), subnets, Route Tables (UDRs), peering, Private Endpoints, and private DNS zones. Network RBAC & Identity Governance: Strong expertise in designing and enforcing least-privilege access using Azure Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), custom role definitions, scope hierarchies (Management Groups down to Resource Groups), and Entra ID/Azure AD controls. Infrastructure Upgrades & Patching: Hands-on experience planning and executing zero-downtime platform upgrades, OS patching, database version upgrades, TLS certificate rotations, and runtime deprecation cycles. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Scripting: Strong proficiency writing modular, production-ready code in Terraform or Bicep/ARM, paired with scripting skills
